handoff.salientSummary: Implemented the evaluation orchestrator that ties together Job creation, OpenCompass execution, and result collection. The orchestrator creates K8s ConfigMap/Secret resources for evaluations, starts monitoring, and handles cleanup on completion. All tests pass and code builds successfully.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created evaluation orchestrator in internal/service/orchestrator.go that: (1) Manages full lifecycle of evaluations by creating K8s ConfigMap with OpenCompass configuration and Secret with API keys, then spawning Job; (2) Integrates with evaluation handler via OrchestratorInterface to start Job when POST /api/v1/evaluations creates a task and to cancel Job when DELETE is called; (3) Implements result collection that parses OpenCompass output and stores results/predictions in DB; (4) Provides cleanup that removes Job, ConfigMap, and Secret resources after completion; (5) Includes background result collector that monitors Job completion events and triggers collection/cleanup; (6) Updated main.go to initialize K8s client, monitor, and orchestrator; (7) Fixed configmap generator to use kubernetes.Interface instead of *kubernetes.Clientset for compatibility.
